parameters.name: AcrRegistryInfo
parameters.description: The information about the Container Registry (ACR) Enterprise Edition instance.

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description: The domain names of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance. By default, all domain names of the instance are used. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region where the ACR Enterprise Edition instance is located.

parameters.name: AutoMatchImageCache
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable reuse of image cache layers. If you enable this feature, the system reuses the image layers of existing image caches to accelerate the creation of image caches. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value that is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The elastic IP address (EIP). To pull images from the Internet, ensure that the ECI instance has Internet access. Configure an EIP or a NAT Gateway to enable Internet access.

parameters.name: EliminationStrategy
parameters.description:
The eviction policy for the image cache. By default, the image cache is never evicted.

Set this parameter to \`LRU\` to allow automatic deletion. If you set the policy to \`LRU\`, when the number of image caches reaches the quota, the system automatically deletes the least recently used caches.

parameters.name: Flash
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the instant image cache feature. This feature accelerates the creation of image caches. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: FlashCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of local snapshot replicas. By default, one snapshot is created for one image cache. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in batches, configure this parameter to create multiple snapshot replicas. We recommend creating one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> If the instant image cache feature is enabled (Flash is set to true), the system first creates local snapshots. After the local snapshots are created, the system starts to create standard snapshots. After the standard snapshots are created, the local snapshots are automatically deleted.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description:
The list of container images used to create the image cache.

> If you want to trigger an in-place upgrade of the image cache without updating the image list, you must still pass the image list. Otherwise, the image data is not updated to the latest version. Only the metadata is refreshed.

parameters.name: ImageCacheId
parameters.description: The ID of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheName
parameters.description: The name of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheSize
parameters.description: The size of the image cache. The default value is 20 GiB.

parameters.name: ImageRegistryCredential
parameters.description: The credentials of the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Password
sub_parameters.description: The password for the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Server
sub_parameters.description: The address of the image repository. Do not include the `http://` or `https://` prefix.

sub_parameters.name: UserName
sub_parameters.description: The username for the image repository.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description:
The retention period of the image cache in days. The image cache expires and is cleared after the retention period ends. By default, the image cache never expires.

> Image caches that failed to be created are retained for only one day.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group.

parameters.name: StandardCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of standard snapshot replicas. By default, one snapshot is created for one image cache. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in batches, configure this parameter to create multiple snapshot replicas. We recommend creating one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> If the instant image cache feature is disabled (Flash is set to false), only standard snapshots are created when the image cache is being created.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to attach to the image cache. You can attach up to 20 tags.
